purpose: Teach: 加地/今春/新選/正門/Ａ子/坂井/当地/親方

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの加地と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, I saw you — you were talking to Kaji from the next class over.
lines.style: Sly, drawn-out opening accusation. Teasing Kansai lilt, the raised eyebrow practically audible.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、卒業文集で「今春卒業」って書いてたな、桜
lines.en: Well you're the one who wrote 'graduating this spring' in the yearbook, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat deadpan counter, half-mumbled cool, the comeback tossed off like it's nothing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新選組グッズ集めてたな
lines.en: Riku, you've been collecting Shinsengumi merch, haven't you.
lines.style: Mock-scandalized, savoring the reveal. Pace quickens into the accusation, grin barely contained.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、学校の正門で待ち合わせしてたろ、桜
lines.en: And you were waiting for somebody at the school's front gate, weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Low, pointed counterattack with a knowing little pause before her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、新聞の「Ａ子(仮名)」の記事読んでたな
lines.en: Riku, I caught you reading that newspaper piece about 'A-ko' — name withheld.
lines.style: Stage-whispered gotcha, delighting in the detail, sarcasm riding the quoted name.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの坂井と話してたな、桜
lines.en: You were talking to Sakai from the next class, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick clipped return fire, voice cracking slightly upward on the name, pretending it didn't.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「当地のラーメンが一番」って自慢してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were literally bragging that 'the local ramen here is the best.'
lines.style: Exaggerated impression of him on the quote, then a snort of laughter held back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、相撲の親方になりたいって言ってたろ、桜
lines.en: Yeah? You said you wanted to become a sumo stablemaster, Sakura.
lines.style: Final jab delivered slow and smug, landing the absurd detail, then going quiet.
